requirements_note: Matrix values/duration/repetitions are engineering choices calibrated against completed T04-T07 evidence; they are not numerical requirements from the source documents.

run_order.policy: sequential; one worker, one Compose project at a time; no concurrent cells
run_order.block_order: repeat the same deterministic SHA-256 cell permutation for normal/burst/mixed/scaling, then run the outage pair block; three repetition blocks
run_order.replacement_limit: At most two total replacement attempts per non-outage cell across all three planned repetitions. For each outage policy, at most two paired replacements across the study; a pair repeats that policy's healthy gate and, only if it passes, the matching outage phase. Every attempt uses a new output path; preserve all failed and replaced attempts.

budget.replacement_bound: 84 non-outage replacement phases (2 per each of 42 cells) plus 8 outage replacement phases (2 pairs per policy); at most 230 total run phases including 138 planned phases.
budget.host: single Linux/WSL2 Docker host; 12 logical CPUs, 7.436 GiB Docker-reported memory; no service cgroup limits; no concurrent unrelated workload

runtime.container_resource_limits: none declared in Compose; single-run sequential execution is required
runtime.image_revalidation: Before each run, store docker compose images --format json and docker image inspect output. Require configured base tag and inspected ID/digest to match the pinned base image. Stage 1 captured inspect Config.Env REDIS_VERSION=7.4.2, matching the configured tag; it did not capture a live INFO server response, so report the immutable image identity and inspect build metadata without claiming a separately observed server-reported version. Rebuilt project images may have new IDs; report-study fingerprint must match within a cell.
runtime.source_revision_note: Pinned measurement-tool revision: 0291a80fb404fea0eafee8c3431acc3631bb423e, including the normal-cell outcome-gate correction. This is helper-only code based on the v1 source b090d2b7391db873a0a2bbe602321ed1f5a55691; no application or workload behavior changed.

recovery.threshold_origin: T07 healthy calibration, 1.5× each policy matched healthy legitimate-success p95, locked before T09. Do not recalculate or tune.
recovery.runner_behavior: scripts/redis-outage.sh dynamically computes 1.5× from each formal healthy run and applies it to its outage analysis. Preserve those dynamic analysis.json/analysis.md/analyzer.log and per-policy recovery-p95-threshold-ms.txt. For the locked result, copy the dynamic artifacts to *.dynamic-t07.*, then rerun scripts/analyze.py on each outage case with the frozen policy threshold and fixed window/sample/consecutive flags; the resulting analysis.json/analysis.md are the fixed-threshold report-study inputs. Keep the dynamic threshold file untouched.

network_metrics.sampler: research-pilot starts scripts/lab-common.sh lab_sample before the offered load; T08 validated TERM completion and matched API traffic. Do not sample during Redis pause/outage.
network_metrics.interval: first to last valid Redis INFO stats sample timestamps; report the observed interval in seconds with rates
network_metrics.semantics: cumulative Redis TCP counter deltas in bytes and bytes/second; total Redis traffic including workload, sampler INFO cpu/memory/stats, healthchecks and admin boundary commands; not pure limiter bytes/request and not wire/packet overhead
network_metrics.cadence_limit: T08 observed five samples at 2.29–2.42 s intervals despite one-second sleep because three sequential Compose exec calls dominate.
network_metrics.missing: incomplete and null when any sample lacks the counter
network_metrics.decrease: inconclusive and null if observed counter decreases; reset between samples can remain hidden
network_metrics.overhead: T08 paired 20-RPS traffic: output 844 B/s off vs 2059 B/s on, one pair only; contamination observed, no correction factor or latency conclusion.

atomicity_rq4.evidence: Use completed T06 real-Redis concurrent/shared and near-empty Fixed Window/Token Bucket invariant tests and forced non-atomic barrier control.
atomicity_rq4.claim_boundary: Recorded invariants/control only; not HTTP behavior/performance, natural race frequency, or a new formal T09 cell.

report_study_adapter.conversion: After actual outputs exist, create a distinct result manifest at docs/experiments/protocol-v1.1/results/manifest.json. Each run path is resolved relative to that result manifest (four levels up to repository root, then artifacts/...). Use the actual accepted case directory from the execution ledger, including any replacement path; do not mechanically copy a planned path when a replacement was selected. Keep the planning manifest unchanged.

acceptance.normal_mixed_scaling: Use the lock in protocol.md: exact source/config/image fingerprint, phase/class rate fidelity within ±5%, zero drops, scheduled=trace count, sent+dropped reconciliation, schedule lag p95 ≤ min(10 ms, 1000/target class RPS), wall/monotonic residual ≤5 ms, trace/counter/backend reconciliation, complete analysis, correct topology/policy and fresh state; healthy Redis limiter errors must be zero. Intended mixed/backend overload and expected outage fallback are outcomes, not tooling errors.
acceptance.burst: Evaluate separate legitimate/abusive classes in [0,2), [2,4), [4,30) seconds; each class/phase must meet ±5% where target >0 and lag p95 bound using that phase rate.
acceptance.outage: Existing runner healthy gate must pass before its corresponding pause: all legitimate successes, zero drops, transport errors, limiter errors, API limiter errors, and backend overload; afterward apply the same full per-class/phase/counter/clock checks, and record all four pause/unpause UTC transitions.
acceptance.outcome: Oracle result is separate from validity; preserve FW inconclusive and observed violations. Do not change thresholds after viewing data.

attempt_paths.replacement_template: <planned-output-path>.attempt-N, where N starts at 1 for the first replacement of that cell or outage policy; never reuse a planned or previous attempt path.
attempt_paths.actual_path_rule: Record the actual case directory used for every attempt in the external execution ledger. Quality checking and result export consume that actual path; do not infer it from the planned path when a replacement ran. Planned result_path values are result-manifest-relative paths; the coordinator matches their artifacts/protocol-v1.1 suffix against output_path and roots planned attempts at the repository artifacts directory.
attempt_paths.accepted_attempts: Exactly three quality-passing attempts per cell, when available; preserve every rejected attempt and reason.

replacement_policy.non_outage: At most two replacement attempts total per cell across all three planned repetitions. No additional retry if all three planned attempts pass.
replacement_policy.outage: At most two paired replacement attempts per policy across the whole study. Each pair runs healthy then matching outage under the same policy/config; the outage runs only after the runner healthy gate passes. A replacement is not one replacement per phase.
replacement_policy.paths: Every retry gets a new output directory and actual paths are recorded; failed attempts remain preserved and excluded only from accepted result manifest.

protocol_v1_1_changes.retained: All 46 cells, 138 planned slots, 30 s duration, three repetitions, scientific configuration values, thresholds, and the v1 deterministic within-block ordering are unchanged.
protocol_v1_1_changes.outage_execution: Each v1 outage invocation that created both policies is replaced by two invocations: one open pair and one closed pair per repetition. Total invocation count is 132: 126 standard runs plus six outage policy pairs.
protocol_v1_1_changes.historical_v1_gaps: Protocol v1 remains immutable history. Its original invocation combined open/closed policies, had no per-invocation quality-manifest/run-ID callback contract, and did not define the newly requested two-total-replacement limit per non-outage cell. V1.1 makes policy calls and replacement/path tracking explicit.
protocol_v1_1_changes.current_tool_limits: The bounded stage-1 smoke passed the documented standard, open/closed outage, fixed-analysis, and invalid-healthy-ID stop checks. It did not start a formal run. Run a fresh clock observer before the formal sequence and use the pinned clean checkout and the fixed manifest without changing thresholds.
protocol_v1_1_changes.authorization: This document and self-check do not authorize T09 measurements. Resume/execution gates remain in the checkpoint and require explicit user authorization.
protocol_v1_1_changes.source_provenance: Source revision b090d2b7391db873a0a2bbe602321ed1f5a55691 underlies locked protocol v1. The v1.1 measurement tools are helper-only revisions, committed at the source_revision pin above; no application or workload behavior changed. The latest checker-only correction gates no-overload validity on the actual normal block, so scaling at 250 RPS retains its intended backend-bound outcome. The protocol document and manifest are separate documentation artifacts and their commit does not change the measurement source pin.
protocol_v1_1_changes.provenance_and_artifacts: The coordinator runs scripts/run-study.py from the pinned clone with --manifest <absolute main protocol manifest> and --output <fresh external result directory> (plus --resume only when resuming). Raw artifacts stay under the pinned clone ignored artifacts/protocol-v1.1; execution ledger and result outputs stay in the external output directory.
protocol_v1_1_changes.known_execution_limits: Phase-specific failures stop that phase according to the runner gates; retain evidence and use only the bounded replacement allowance. A guest/host suspension invalidates the active attempt and stops the sequence pending observer/clock review; no automatic resume changes a frozen threshold or reuses an output path.

attempt_path_policy: Planned run rows name first-attempt outputs. For a replacement, execution ledger stores the actual case path; quality checker receives that path explicitly. All planned and replacement outputs must be unique.

smoke_validation.status: passed; bounded integration smoke only; no formal T09 run started
smoke_validation.verified: Archive extraction and full internal SHA256SUMS verification passed.
smoke_validation.coverage: Standard normal-none p1-003 passed; corrected open healthy/outage pair passed; closed healthy/outage pair passed and fixed recovery analysis at 82.577208 was accepted; wrong healthy run ID failed closed before pause or outage creation.
smoke_validation.limits: One bounded standard cell and outage-policy smoke coverage only; this validates integration gates and callbacks, not matrix-wide performance or scientific conclusions. The initially misconfigured open attempt and earlier launcher/checker failures remain archived and excluded.
